name: Certified Associate in Project Management
name_ja: プロジェクトマネジメント・アソシエイト認定

logistics.format: Computer-based multiple-choice exam at Pearson VUE; online proctored option available

formal: Secondary degree (high school diploma or global equivalent)
23 contact hours of project management education completed before the exam

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced foundational: 2, introductory: 1. The ordered median is foundational. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Japanese availability and a recognized project framework support an entry management foundation after required education; zero experience and limited exam depth do not establish project leadership or security expertise.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Required introductory education and a recognized project framework establish foundational project-management knowledge. Zero experience, limited depth and nontechnical multiple-choice assessment do not demonstrate independent delivery leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded open-entry project-management examination supplies conceptual groundwork after introductory education. Its multiple-choice format and lack of technical security scope make it pre-professional supporting literacy.
